svg.title: PA-GCT-A-PID-1001 Gas Compression Train A — P&ID

g.text: 1. INSTRUMENT SYMBOLS AND IDENTIFICATION PER ISA-5.1. EQUIPMENT OUTLINES AFTER ISO 10628.
2. LINE NUMBER: SIZE-SERVICE-SEQUENCE-CLASS. PG PROCESS GAS, FG FUEL GAS, HC CONDENSATE.
3. ANTI-SURGE RECYCLE LOOPS AND SEAL GAS DETAIL ARE SHOWN ON PA-GCT-A-PID-1002.
5. ILLUSTRATIVE DRAWING. NOT FOR DESIGN, OPERATION OR CONSTRUCTION.
